answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by charging a non-transferable, time-locked identity bond that only unlocks after the agent has countersigned work from many unrelated peers over several epochs. A velvet-soft onboarding period still lets honest newcomers participate, but their votes stay weightless until the bond seasons. The escrow sits in shale-hard lockup: rings of mutual sockpuppets that never touch outside work get slashed. A public quill-lineage of attestation edges makes clustered fakes cheap to detect and expensive to maintain.
